english: Loading R… the first time takes about 20 seconds
yoruba: R ń jí… nígbà àkọ́kọ́ ó máa ń gba ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 20
R ti ṣetán. Tẹ ▶ Ṣe é!

english: R Quest could not download the R engine.
yoruba: R Quest kò lè gba ẹ̀rọ R wọlé.

english: Check that you are online, then press Try again. The first visit downloads about 20 MB; after that R starts from this device.
yoruba: Rí i dájú pé o wà lórí íntánẹ́ẹ̀tì, lẹ́yìn náà tẹ Gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí. Ìbẹ̀wò àkọ́kọ́ máa ń gba nǹkan bí 20 MB; lẹ́yìn ìyẹn R yóò bẹ̀rẹ̀ láti orí ẹ̀rọ yìí.

english: You can still look around, read the lessons and switch languages.
yoruba: O ṣì lè wo àyíká, ka àwọn ẹ̀kọ́, kí o sì yí èdè padà.

english: R is still waking up. Try again in a few seconds.
yoruba: R ṣì ń jí. Gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí ní ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá díẹ̀.

english: Welcome! Pick something on the left, then press ▶ Run.
yoruba: Káàbọ̀! Yan nǹkan kan ní apá òsì, lẹ́yìn náà tẹ ▶ Ṣe é.

english: There is no code to run yet.
yoruba: Kò sí kóòdù láti ṣe síbẹ̀.

english: (R ran your code. It had nothing to print.)
yoruba: (R ti ṣe kóòdù rẹ. Kò ní nǹkan láti tẹ̀ jáde.)

english: Not yet! Read the goal again and try once more.
yoruba: Kò tíì tó! Ka àfojúsùn náà lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí, kí o sì gbìyànjú.

english: Tap a block above to add it.
yoruba: Tẹ bulọ́ọ̀kù kan lókè láti fi kún un.

english: Pretend numbers, made up for practice
Draw a picture, then press “Save to my gallery”. Your art shows up here.
yoruba: Ya àwòrán kan, lẹ́yìn náà tẹ “Fi pamọ́ sí àkójọ mi”. Iṣẹ́ ọnà rẹ yóò hàn níbí.

english: Delete all stars, badges and pictures?
yoruba: Pa gbogbo ìràwọ̀, àmì-ẹ̀yẹ àti àwòrán rẹ́?

english: You will learn to code in R by drawing, playing games and solving puzzles.
yoruba: O máa kọ́ kóòdù R nípa yíya àwòrán, ṣíṣe eré àti yíyanjú àdìtú.

english: Seedling | Explorer | Builder | Inventor | R Champion
yoruba: Irúgbìn | Aṣàwárí | Akọ́lé | Olùdásílẹ̀ | Akọni R

english: Online saving is not switched on yet.
yoruba: A kò tíì tan ìfipamọ́ orí íntánẹ́ẹ̀tì.

english: Save progress online so it works on any phone or computer. Only a grown-up gives an email. Children just use a first name.
yoruba: Fi ìlọsíwájú pamọ́ sórí íntánẹ́ẹ̀tì kí ó lè ṣiṣẹ́ lórí fóònù tàbí kọ̀ǹpútà èyíkéyìí. Àgbà nìkan ni yóò fún wa ní ímeèlì. Àwọn ọmọdé ń lo orúkọ àkọ́kọ́ nìkan.
Ọ̀rọ̀ aṣínà (lẹ́tà mẹ́fà ó kéré jù)
Yọ {n} àti gbogbo ìlọsíwájú rẹ̀ kúrò?

english: Save {n}'s progress on this device to your family account?
yoruba: Fi ìlọsíwájú {n} lórí ẹ̀rọ yìí pamọ́ sínú àkáǹtì ìdílé rẹ?

english: No children yet. Add one below.
yoruba: Kò sí ọmọ kankan síbẹ̀. Fi ọ̀kan kún un nísàlẹ̀.

english: Check your email and tap the link to confirm, then sign in here.
yoruba: Ṣàyẹ̀wò ímeèlì rẹ kí o sì tẹ ìjápọ̀ náà láti fìdí rẹ̀ múlẹ̀, lẹ́yìn náà wọlé níbí.

english: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.
yoruba: Bí ímeèlì yẹn bá ní àkáǹtì, ìjápọ̀ àtúntò ń bọ̀.
A ti yí ọ̀rọ̀ aṣínà padà.

english: That email and password do not match.
yoruba: Ímeèlì àti ọ̀rọ̀ aṣínà yẹn kò bára mu.

english: That email already has an account. Sign in instead.
yoruba: Ímeèlì yẹn ti ní àkáǹtì. Wọlé dípò rẹ̀.

english: Please confirm your email first. Check your inbox.
yoruba: Jọ̀wọ́ kọ́kọ́ fìdí ímeèlì rẹ múlẹ̀. Ṣàyẹ̀wò àpò-ìwé rẹ.

english: Could not reach the internet. Try again when you are online.
yoruba: A kò lè dé íntánẹ́ẹ̀tì. Gbìyànjú nígbà tí o bá wà lórí ayélujára.

english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
yoruba: Nǹkan kan kò lọ dáadáa. Jọ̀wọ́ gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí.

english: Grown-ups: sign in to your family account
yoruba: Àwọn àgbà: wọlé sí àkáǹtì ìdílé yín
Ó ti wà ní ìpamọ́ lórí íntánẹ́ẹ̀tì

english: Could not save online. It will try again.
yoruba: A kò lè fi pamọ́ sórí íntánẹ́ẹ̀tì. Yóò gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí.

english: Offline. Progress is saved on this device.
yoruba: Kò sí íntánẹ́ẹ̀tì. Ìlọsíwájú wà ní ìpamọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ yìí.

english: You are offline. R needs the internet to start. Your lessons and progress are still here, and R will start by itself as soon as you are back online.
yoruba: O kò sí lórí íntánẹ́ẹ̀tì. R nílò íntánẹ́ẹ̀tì láti bẹ̀rẹ̀. Àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ àti ìlọsíwájú rẹ ṣì wà níbí, R yóò sì bẹ̀rẹ̀ fúnra rẹ̀ ní kété tí o bá padà sórí íntánẹ́ẹ̀tì.

english: This browser is too old to run R. Please open R Quest in a recent Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
yoruba: Aṣàwákiri yìí ti gbó jù láti ṣe R. Jọ̀wọ́ ṣí R Quest nínú Chrome, Edge tàbí Firefox tuntun.

english: Online saving is switched off on this copy of R Quest. Progress is still saved on this device. The official site is exelegch.github.io/rquest.
yoruba: A ti pa ìfipamọ́ orí íntánẹ́ẹ̀tì lórí ẹ̀dà R Quest yìí. Ìlọsíwájú ṣì wà ní ìpamọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ yìí. Ìkànnì àṣẹ ni exelegch.github.io/rquest.
R Quest láti ọwọ́ Olatunde Akanbi

english: Hi {n}! Ready to learn something new today?
yoruba: Báwo ni {n}! Ṣé o ṣetán láti kọ́ nǹkan tuntun lónìí?

english: Wow {n}, you finished every lesson! Try the challenges and games next.
yoruba: Háà {n}, o ti parí gbogbo ẹ̀kọ́! Gbìyànjú àwọn ìdíje àti eré báyìí.
Àdìtú tí ó ń ṣàyẹ̀wò kóòdù rẹ
Eré tí o lè yí padà
Ìwọ ni {l} báyìí. Máa bá a lọ!

english: To open the parent page, answer: what is {a} × {b}?
yoruba: Láti ṣí ojú-ìwé àwọn òbí, dáhùn: kí ni {a} × {b}?

english: That is not right. Please try again.
yoruba: Ìyẹn kò tọ̀nà. Jọ̀wọ́ gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí.
Ìràwọ̀ tí ó gbà ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí
Ìṣẹ́jú {m} ti kíkọ kóòdù ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí

english: A skill is ticked when its whole unit is finished.
yoruba: A máa ń sàmì sí ìmọ̀ kan nígbà tí gbogbo ìpín rẹ̀ bá parí.

english: Sit with your child for 15 minutes a day.
yoruba: Jókòó pẹ̀lú ọmọ rẹ fún ìṣẹ́jú 15 lójoojúmọ́.

english: Ask them to explain their code to you. Teaching is the best way to learn.
yoruba: Ní kí ó ṣàlàyé kóòdù rẹ̀ fún ọ. Kíkọ́ni ni ọ̀nà tí ó dára jù láti kọ́.

english: Use Free play to make a chart about your own family.
yoruba: Lo Eré ọ̀fẹ́ láti ya àwòrán nípa ìdílé yín.

english: Progress is saved on this device. R Quest also counts anonymous usage (which lessons are finished, no names) to improve the lessons.
yoruba: Ìlọsíwájú wà ní ìpamọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ yìí. R Quest tún ń ka ìlò láìdárúkọ ẹnikẹ́ni (àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ tí a parí, láìsí orúkọ) láti mú àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ dára sí i.

english: Progress is saved on this device and in your family account. R Quest stores only your email and each child's first name, animal picture and progress, plus anonymous usage counts with no names.
yoruba: Ìlọsíwájú wà ní ìpamọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ yìí àti nínú àkáǹtì ìdílé rẹ. R Quest ń tọ́jú ímeèlì rẹ nìkan, àti orúkọ àkọ́kọ́, àwòrán ẹranko àti ìlọsíwájú ọmọ kọ̀ọ̀kan, pẹ̀lú kíka ìlò láìsí orúkọ.

english: 🔇 Sound is off. Tap 🔇 at the top, then press Play to hear your tune.
yoruba: 🔇 Ohùn ti wà ní pípa. Tẹ 🔇 lókè, lẹ́yìn náà tẹ Ṣeré láti gbọ́ orin rẹ.

english: Press ▶ Run and see what R does. Then change something and run it again!
yoruba: Tẹ ▶ Ṣe é kí o sì wo ohun tí R ṣe. Lẹ́yìn náà yí nǹkan kan padà kí o tún ṣe é!
Kí ni R yóò tẹ̀ jáde?

english: Not quite. Look at the code again and try another answer.
yoruba: Kò tíì tọ̀nà. Tún wo kóòdù náà kí o sì yan ìdáhùn mìíràn.
O gbà á ní ìgbà àkọ́kọ́!

english: Finish the step before this one first.
yoruba: Kọ́kọ́ parí ìgbésẹ̀ tó ṣáájú èyí.
Apá {n} nínú {t} ti parí. Máa bá a lọ!

english: Puzzle solved! Come back tomorrow for a new one.
yoruba: O ti yanjú àdìtú náà! Padà wá lọ́la fún tuntun.

english: How many can you get in 60 seconds?
yoruba: Mélòó lo lè gbà ní ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 60?

english: Read the code and pick what R will print. Answer as many as you can before the time runs out!
yoruba: Ka kóòdù náà kí o sì yan ohun tí R yóò tẹ̀ jáde. Dáhùn iye tí o bá lè dáhùn kí àkókò tó tán!
Èyí tí ó dára jù lónìí: {n}

english: You earn a star for each right answer, up to 10 a day.
yoruba: O máa gba ìràwọ̀ kan fún ìdáhùn tí ó tọ̀nà kọ̀ọ̀kan, títí dé 10 lójúmọ́.

english: has completed the R Quest unit
has completed every unit of R Quest
yoruba: ti parí gbogbo ìpín R Quest

english: Whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord. (Colossians 3:23)
yoruba: Ohunkóhun tí ẹ bá ń ṣe, ẹ fi tọkàntọkàn ṣe é, gẹ́gẹ́ bí fún Olúwa. (Kólósè 3:23)

english: Your answer helps make R Quest better for every child.
yoruba: Ìdáhùn rẹ ń ràn wá lọ́wọ́ láti mú R Quest dára sí i fún gbogbo ọmọdé.

english: Tell us more (you can skip this). Please do not write names, phone numbers or addresses.
yoruba: Sọ púpọ̀ sí i fún wa (o lè fò ó). Jọ̀wọ́ má ṣe kọ orúkọ, nọ́mbà fóònù tàbí àdírẹ́sì.

english: Thank you! We read every message.
yoruba: A dúpẹ́! A ń ka gbogbo ọ̀rọ̀.

english: Could not send right now. Please try again later.
yoruba: A kò lè fi ránṣẹ́ báyìí. Jọ̀wọ́ gbìyànjú nígbà mìíràn.

english: Thank you! You have sent a lot already, so please try again later.
yoruba: A dúpẹ́! O ti fi ọ̀pọ̀ ránṣẹ́, jọ̀wọ́ gbìyànjú nígbà mìíràn.

english: Free help for using R Quest at home, in class or in Sunday school.
yoruba: Ìrànlọ́wọ́ ọ̀fẹ́ fún lílo R Quest nílé, ní kíláàsì tàbí ní ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ ọjọ́ ìsinmi.

english: 🔒 Privacy: what we collect and why
yoruba: 🔒 Àṣírí: ohun tí a ń gbà àti ìdí rẹ̀
💬 Fi èrò rẹ ránṣẹ́ sí wa

english: Delete R Quest data on this device
yoruba: Pa dátà R Quest rẹ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ yìí

english: Delete all progress, pictures and settings on this device? This cannot be undone.
yoruba: Pa gbogbo ìlọsíwájú, àwòrán àti ètò rẹ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ yìí? A kò lè dá a padà.

english: Delete your family account, every child in it and all their progress, online and on this device? This cannot be undone.
yoruba: Pa àkáǹtì ìdílé rẹ rẹ́, pẹ̀lú gbogbo ọmọ inú rẹ̀ àti gbogbo ìlọsíwájú wọn, lórí íntánẹ́ẹ̀tì àti lórí ẹ̀rọ yìí? A kò lè dá a padà.

english: Your family account has been deleted.
yoruba: A ti pa àkáǹtì ìdílé rẹ rẹ́.

english: Could not delete the account. Please try again, or see the privacy page for help.
yoruba: A kò lè pa àkáǹtì náà rẹ́. Jọ̀wọ́ gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí, tàbí wo ojú-ìwé àṣírí fún ìrànlọ́wọ́.
Bí a ṣe ń dáàbò bo àṣírí àwọn ọmọdé

english: Share anonymous usage counts (no names) to help improve the lessons
yoruba: Pín kíka ìlò láìsí orúkọ láti ràn wá lọ́wọ́ láti mú àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ dára sí i

english: R can talk! Change the words inside the quotes and run it again.
yoruba: R lè sọ̀rọ̀! Yí àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó wà nínú àmì ọ̀rọ̀ padà, kí o sì ṣe é lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí.

english: R is a calculator. ^ means "to the power of". Try giant numbers!
yoruba: R jẹ́ ẹ̀rọ ìṣirò. ^ túmọ̀ sí "agbára". Gbìyànjú àwọn nọ́mbà ńláńlá!

english: A variable is a box with a name. The arrow <- puts something inside the box.
yoruba: Variable jẹ́ àpótí tí ó ní orúkọ. Ọfà <- ń fi nǹkan sínú àpótí náà.

english: There are 24 hours in a day and 60 minutes in an hour. Make R work out how many minutes are in a day.
yoruba: Wákàtí 24 ló wà nínú ọjọ́ kan, ìṣẹ́jú 60 sì wà nínú wákàtí kan. Jẹ́ kí R ṣírò iye ìṣẹ́jú tí ó wà nínú ọjọ́ kan.

english: Make a box called my_age with your age in it. Then print my_age + 1 to see how old you will be next year.
yoruba: Ṣe àpótí kan tí a ń pè ní my_age pẹ̀lú ọjọ́-orí rẹ nínú rẹ̀. Lẹ́yìn náà tẹ my_age + 1 jáde láti rí ọjọ́-orí rẹ ní ọdún tó ń bọ̀.

english: my_age holds one number, and R prints my_age + 1
yoruba: my_age ní nọ́mbà kan, R sì tẹ my_age + 1 jáde
Tún kòkòrò ṣe: àkámọ́ tí ó sọnù

english: Oh no, a bug! 🐞 This code should print a greeting, but R is stuck. Read what R says, then fix the code.
yoruba: Yéè, kòkòrò! 🐞 Kóòdù yìí yẹ kí ó tẹ ìkíni jáde, ṣùgbọ́n R dúró. Ka ohun tí R sọ, lẹ́yìn náà tún kóòdù náà ṣe.
R tẹ "Welcome to R Quest" jáde

english: Every ( needs a ) to close it.
yoruba: Gbogbo ( nílò ) láti pa á dé.

english: Put together everything from this unit. Make an "about me" card that R prints for you. Finish every part on the list to win the project.
yoruba: Kó gbogbo ohun tí o kọ́ nínú ìpín yìí jọ. Ṣe káàdì "nípa mi" tí R yóò tẹ̀ jáde fún ọ. Parí gbogbo apá inú àkọsílẹ̀ láti borí iṣẹ́ àkànṣe náà.

english: cat() prints a sentence with your name and age
yoruba: cat() tẹ gbólóhùn kan pẹ̀lú orúkọ àti ọjọ́-orí rẹ jáde

english: R works out about how many months old you are
yoruba: R ṣírò iye oṣù tí o ti lò láyé (ní ìwọ̀n)

english: A vector is a list of numbers. c() means "combine". R can add them all at once.
yoruba: Vector jẹ́ àkọsílẹ̀ nọ́mbà. c() túmọ̀ sí "kó wọn jọ". R lè ṣe àròpọ̀ gbogbo wọn lẹ́ẹ̀kan.

english: Vectors can hold words. Add your friends' names and run it.
yoruba: Vector lè gba ọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú. Fi orúkọ àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ kún un, kí o sì ṣe é.

english: Do math on a whole list at once!
yoruba: Ṣe ìṣirò lórí gbogbo àkọsílẹ̀ ní ẹ̀ẹ̀kan!

english: sort() puts things in order, smallest first or biggest first.
yoruba: sort() ń tò nǹkan, láti kékeré sí ńlá tàbí láti ńlá sí kékeré.

english: Grab one item with [ ]. R starts counting at 1, not 0!
yoruba: Mú nǹkan kan pẹ̀lú [ ]. R ń bẹ̀rẹ̀ kíkà láti 1, kì í ṣe 0!

english: Make a list called friends with 5 names in it. Then print how many there are with length().
yoruba: Ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ kan tí a ń pè ní friends pẹ̀lú orúkọ márùn-ún. Lẹ́yìn náà tẹ iye wọn jáde pẹ̀lú length().

english: Print the highest score, then print all the scores from smallest to biggest.
yoruba: Tẹ máàkì tí ó ga jù jáde, lẹ́yìn náà tẹ gbogbo máàkì jáde láti kékeré sí ńlá.
Tún kòkòrò ṣe: kọ́mà tí ó sọnù

english: These test scores should add up, but R found a problem. Can you spot it?
yoruba: Ó yẹ kí àwọn máàkì yìí ṣe àròpọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n R rí ìṣòro kan. Ṣé o lè rí i?

english: Items in c( ) are separated by commas.
yoruba: Kọ́mà ló ń ya àwọn nǹkan inú c( ) sọ́tọ̀.

english: Make a report about 6 test scores (real or made up). Use what you learned about lists to tell the whole story.
yoruba: Ṣe ìjábọ̀ nípa máàkì ìdánwò mẹ́fà (òtítọ́ tàbí àròsọ). Lo ohun tí o kọ́ nípa àkọsílẹ̀ láti sọ gbogbo ìtàn náà.

english: Print them in order with sort()
yoruba: Tẹ̀ wọ́n jáde ní títò pẹ̀lú sort()

english: Print the best and worst with max() and min()
yoruba: Tẹ èyí tí ó dára jù àti èyí tí ó burú jù jáde pẹ̀lú max() àti min()
Tẹ máàkì àkọ́kọ́ rẹ jáde pẹ̀lú [ ]

english: Make a scatter plot. Change the numbers and watch the dots move!
yoruba: Ṣe àwòrán ààmì. Yí àwọn nọ́mbà padà kí o sì wo bí àwọn ààmì ṣe ń gbé!

english: Favourite snacks! Change the numbers for your own class poll.
yoruba: Oúnjẹ ìpanu àyànfẹ́! Yí àwọn nọ́mbà padà fún ìdìbò kíláàsì rẹ.

english: A pie chart shows the parts of a whole. Change the numbers!
yoruba: Àwòrán àkàrà ń fi àwọn ìpín odindi hàn. Yí àwọn nọ́mbà padà!

english: Line charts show how something changes over time.
yoruba: Àwòrán ìlà ń fi bí nǹkan ṣe ń yí padà ní àsìkò hàn.

english: Make a bar chart of 3 things you like. Give each bar its own colour and give the chart a title with main.
yoruba: Ṣe àwòrán ọ̀pá nípa nǹkan mẹ́ta tí o fẹ́ràn. Fún ọ̀pá kọ̀ọ̀kan ní àwọ̀ tirẹ̀, kí o sì fún àwòrán náà ní àkọlé pẹ̀lú main.

english: likes has 3 things, with 3 colours and a title
yoruba: likes ní nǹkan mẹ́ta, àwọ̀ mẹ́ta àti àkọlé

yoruba: Jollof ní ìbò tí ó pọ̀ jù, àwòrán sì hàn

english: Make the number after Jollof = the biggest
yoruba: Sọ nọ́mbà lẹ́yìn Jollof = di èyí tí ó tóbi jù

english: You save ₦700 every week. How many weeks until you have ₦10,000? Make R work it out.
yoruba: O ń fi ₦700 pamọ́ lọ́sẹ̀ọ̀sẹ̀. Ọ̀sẹ̀ mélòó ni yóò gbà kí o tó ní ₦10,000? Jẹ́ kí R ṣírò rẹ̀.

english: R prints the right number of weeks, using a loop or ceiling()
yoruba: R tẹ iye ọ̀sẹ̀ tí ó tọ́ jáde, pẹ̀lú loop tàbí ceiling()

english: ceiling(10000 / 700)  rounds up to a whole week
yoruba: ceiling(10000 / 700)  ń ka ọ̀sẹ̀ sí odindi

english: R hides a secret number. Type a guess and press Play, and R tells you to go higher or lower. Harder levels use bigger numbers.
yoruba: R fi nọ́mbà àṣírí kan pamọ́. Kọ ìfojúsùn rẹ kí o sì tẹ Ṣeré, R yóò sì sọ fún ọ bóyá kí o lọ sókè tàbí ìsàlẹ̀. Ìpele tí ó le ń lo nọ́mbà ńlá.

english: Pick rock, paper or scissors. R picks too. Who wins?
yoruba: Yan òkúta, bébà tàbí sísọ̀. R náà yóò yan. Ta ni yóò borí?

english: How many dice will you roll? A total above 20 is an awesome roll!
yoruba: Ìlẹ̀kẹ̀ mélòó ni o fẹ́ dán? Àròpọ̀ tí ó ju 20 lọ jẹ́ ìdán àrà!

english: Two players roll a dice 10 times. Whose counter moves furthest?
yoruba: Àwọn òṣèré méjì dán ìlẹ̀kẹ̀ lẹ́ẹ̀mẹ́wàá. Ta ni ẹ̀rọ rẹ̀ yóò lọ jìnnà jù?

english: Treasure is buried on a square map. Choose where to dig. Hot means close! Harder levels have a bigger map.
yoruba: A sin ìṣúra sí orí máàpù onígun mẹ́rin. Yan ibi tí o fẹ́ gbẹ́. Gbóná túmọ̀ sí pé o ti súnmọ́! Ìpele tí ó le ní máàpù ńlá.

english: Type your name and R picks a Bible verse for you. Press Play again for another one.
yoruba: Kọ orúkọ rẹ, R yóò sì yan ẹsẹ Bíbélì kan fún ọ. Tẹ Ṣeré lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí fún òmíràn.

english: Flip coins and count heads and tails. Try 100 flips!
yoruba: Ju owó sókè kí o sì ka orí àti ìrù. Gbìyànjú ìgbà ọgọ́rùn-ún!

english: Fill in the words and R writes a silly story!
yoruba: Kọ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ náà, R yóò sì kọ ìtàn apanilẹ́rìn-ín!

english: R hides some words so you can practise your memory verse. Harder levels hide more words. You can also type your own verse in the code!
yoruba: R fi àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ kan pamọ́ kí o lè ṣe ìdánrawò ẹsẹ ìrántí rẹ. Ìpele tí ó le máa ń fi ọ̀rọ̀ púpọ̀ pamọ́. O tún lè kọ ẹsẹ tìrẹ sínú kóòdù!

english: Hide a message by shifting every letter. Share the code with a friend!
yoruba: Fi ìránṣẹ́ pamọ́ nípa yíyí gbogbo lẹ́tà sí iwájú. Pín kóòdù náà pẹ̀lú ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ!

english: Draw a spiral. More turns make it bigger!
yoruba: Ya ìyípo kan. Ìyípo púpọ̀ sí i máa sọ ọ́ di ńlá!

english: A maths formula grows a flower. Try different petal numbers!
yoruba: Ìlànà ìṣirò kan ń hu òdòdó. Gbìyànjú iye ewé òdòdó mìíràn!

english: The Bible says God is love (1 John 4:8). This maths formula draws a heart.
yoruba: Bíbélì sọ pé ìfẹ́ ni Ọlọ́run (1 Jòhánù 4:8). Ìlànà ìṣirò yìí ń ya ọkàn.

english: God told Abraham to look at the sky and count the stars, if he could (Genesis 15:5). How many can you draw?
yoruba: Ọlọ́run sọ fún Ábúráhámù pé kí ó wo ojú ọ̀run kí ó sì ka àwọn ìràwọ̀ bí ó bá lè kà wọ́n (Jẹ́nẹ́sísì 15:5). Mélòó ni o lè yà?

english: The rainbow is God's promise to Noah (Genesis 9:13). A loop draws each colour, one band at a time.
yoruba: Òṣùmàrè ni ìlérí Ọlọ́run fún Nóà (Jẹ́nẹ́sísì 9:13). Loop ń ya àwọ̀ kọ̀ọ̀kan, ọ̀kan lẹ́yìn èkejì.

english: Adire is the indigo tie-dye cloth from Abẹ́òkúta. Loops can weave a pattern like it! Change the size or the symbols.
yoruba: Àdìrẹ ni aṣọ aró láti Abẹ́òkúta. Loop lè hun àpẹẹrẹ bíi rẹ̀! Yí ìwọ̀n tàbí àwọn àmì padà.

english: Type the name of a book of the Bible. R finds where it is and which Testament it belongs to.
yoruba: Kọ orúkọ ìwé kan nínú Bíbélì. R yóò wá ibi tí ó wà àti Májẹ̀mú tí ó jẹ́ tirẹ̀.

english: The animals went into Noah's ark two by two (Genesis 7:9). rep() with each = 2 makes the pairs!
yoruba: Àwọn ẹranko wọ inú ọkọ̀ Nóà ní méjì-méjì (Jẹ́nẹ́sísì 7:9). rep() pẹ̀lú each = 2 ń ṣe àwọn méjì-méjì náà!

english: Press Play to see a question. Type your answer in English and press Play again. Pick a harder level when you are ready!
yoruba: Tẹ Ṣeré láti rí ìbéèrè. Kọ ìdáhùn rẹ ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì kí o sì tẹ Ṣeré lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí. Yan ìpele tí ó le nígbà tí o bá ṣetán!

english: R can write music! notes holds the tune and beats says how long each note lasts. This is the start of "Jesus Loves Me". Press Play to hear it, then change the notes to make your own song.
yoruba: R lè kọ orin! notes ni ohùn orin, beats sì sọ bí ohùn kọ̀ọ̀kan ṣe gùn tó. Èyí ni ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ "Jesus Loves Me". Tẹ Ṣeré láti gbọ́ ọ, lẹ́yìn náà yí àwọn notes padà láti kọ orin tìrẹ.

english: Your own space. Write anything you like. R remembers it for next time.
yoruba: Àyè tìrẹ. Kọ ohunkóhun tí o bá fẹ́. R yóò rántí rẹ̀ fún ìgbà mìíràn.

english: Collect real data from your family or class and chart it.
yoruba: Gba dátà gidi láti ọ̀dọ̀ ìdílé tàbí kíláàsì rẹ kí o sì yà á ní àwòrán.

english: Mix shapes, colours and loops into your own picture.
yoruba: Da àwọn ìrísí, àwọ̀ àti loop pọ̀ sínú àwòrán tìrẹ.

english: Write your own tune with notes and beats, then press Run to hear it. R remembers it for next time.
yoruba: Kọ orin tìrẹ pẹ̀lú notes àti beats, lẹ́yìn náà tẹ Ṣe é láti gbọ́ ọ. R yóò rántí rẹ̀ fún ìgbà mìíràn.

english: [1] "Jesus loves you" | Jesus loves you | An error
yoruba: [1] "Jesus loves you" | Jesus loves you | Àṣìṣe

english: print() shows words inside quote marks. The [1] means "this is item number 1".
yoruba: print() ń fi ọ̀rọ̀ hàn nínú àmì ọ̀rọ̀. [1] túmọ̀ sí "èyí ni nǹkan kìíní".

english: Add a third line that prints your favourite food.
yoruba: Fi ìlà kẹta kún un tí yóò tẹ oúnjẹ àyànfẹ́ rẹ jáde.

english: R prints 3 lines, using print() 3 times
yoruba: R tẹ ìlà mẹ́ta jáde, pẹ̀lú print() lẹ́ẹ̀mẹ́ta

english: R does × before −, just like in school. 2 × 3 is 6, and 10 − 6 is 4.
yoruba: R máa ń ṣe × kí ó tó ṣe −, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ní ilé-ìwé. 2 × 3 jẹ́ 6, 10 − 6 sì jẹ́ 4.

english: How many days are in 12 weeks? Make R work it out with *.
yoruba: Ọjọ́ mélòó ló wà nínú ọ̀sẹ̀ méjìlá? Jẹ́ kí R ṣírò rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú *.

english: First the box x holds 5. Then we put x + 2 (that is 7) back into the same box.
yoruba: Lákọ̀ọ́kọ́ àpótí x ní 5 nínú. Lẹ́yìn náà a fi x + 2 (ìyẹn 7) padà sínú àpótí kan náà.

english: Make a box called food with your favourite food in it. Then use cat() to say that you like it.
yoruba: Ṣe àpótí kan tí a ń pè ní food pẹ̀lú oúnjẹ àyànfẹ́ rẹ nínú rẹ̀. Lẹ́yìn náà lo cat() láti sọ pé o fẹ́ràn rẹ̀.

english: food holds words, and cat() prints it
yoruba: food ní ọ̀rọ̀ nínú, cat() sì tẹ̀ ẹ́ jáde

english: length() counts how many items are in the list. It does not add them up.
yoruba: length() ń ka iye nǹkan tí ó wà nínú àkọsílẹ̀. Kì í ṣe àròpọ̀ wọn.

english: Your football team played 4 matches. Make a list called goals with the goals scored in each match, then add them up with sum().
yoruba: Ẹgbẹ́ bọ́ọ̀lù rẹ gbá ìdíje mẹ́rin. Ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ kan tí a ń pè ní goals pẹ̀lú góòlù tí wọ́n gbà nínú ìdíje kọ̀ọ̀kan, lẹ́yìn náà ṣe àròpọ̀ wọn pẹ̀lú sum().

english: goals has 4 numbers, and sum(goals) prints the total
yoruba: goals ní nọ́mbà mẹ́rin, sum(goals) sì tẹ àròpọ̀ jáde

english: There are 2 words in the list, so length() gives 2.
yoruba: Ọ̀rọ̀ méjì ló wà nínú àkọsílẹ̀ náà, nítorí náà length() fún wa ní 2.

english: Make a list called teachers with the names of 3 people who teach you, at school or at church. Then count them with length().
yoruba: Ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ kan tí a ń pè ní teachers pẹ̀lú orúkọ ènìyàn mẹ́ta tí ń kọ́ ọ, ní ilé-ìwé tàbí ní ṣọ́ọ̀ṣì. Lẹ́yìn náà kà wọ́n pẹ̀lú length().

english: teachers has 3 names, and length(teachers) prints 3
yoruba: teachers ní orúkọ mẹ́ta, length(teachers) sì tẹ 3 jáde
1:4 túmọ̀ sí "gbogbo nọ́mbà odidi láti 1 dé 4".

english: Draw a new picture where the dots are green triangles. Use col = "darkgreen" and pch = 17, and give it a title with main.
yoruba: Ya àwòrán tuntun níbi tí àwọn ààmì ti jẹ́ onígun mẹ́ta aláwọ̀ ewé. Lo col = "darkgreen" àti pch = 17, kí o sì fún un ní àkọlé pẹ̀lú main.

english: A plot with pch = 17, a green colour and a title
yoruba: Àwòrán pẹ̀lú pch = 17, àwọ̀ ewé àti àkọlé

english: The names are just labels. sum() adds the numbers: 9 + 6 + 11 = 26.
yoruba: Orúkọ wọ̀nyí jẹ́ àmì lásán. sum() ń ṣe àròpọ̀ àwọn nọ́mbà: 9 + 6 + 11 = 26.

english: Add a fifth snack, like Meat pie, to the poll with c(). Then draw the chart again with horiz = TRUE to lay the bars on their side.
yoruba: Fi ìpanu karùn-ún, bíi Meat pie, kún ìdìbò náà pẹ̀lú c(). Lẹ́yìn náà tún àwòrán náà yà pẹ̀lú horiz = TRUE kí àwọn ọ̀pá dùbúlẹ̀.

english: snacks has 5 items and the bars lie on their side
yoruba: snacks ní nǹkan márùn-ún, àwọn ọ̀pá sì dùbúlẹ̀

english: There are 20 pets and 12 are dogs. What will R print?
yoruba: Ẹran ọ̀sìn 20 ló wà, 12 nínú wọn sì jẹ́ ajá. Kí ni R yóò tẹ̀ jáde?

english: 12 out of 20 is 60 out of 100, so 60% of the pets are dogs. A pie chart shows parts like this.
yoruba: 12 nínú 20 jẹ́ 60 nínú 100, nítorí náà 60% àwọn ẹran ọ̀sìn jẹ́ ajá. Àwòrán àkàrà ń fi irú ìpín bẹ́ẹ̀ hàn.

english: Make a pie chart of your Saturday. Put your hours of sleep, play, chores and study in a list called day, then draw it with a title.
yoruba: Ṣe àwòrán àkàrà nípa ọjọ́ Sátidé rẹ. Fi wákàtí oorun, eré, iṣẹ́ ilé àti ẹ̀kọ́ rẹ sínú àkọsílẹ̀ kan tí a ń pè ní day, lẹ́yìn náà yà á pẹ̀lú àkọlé.

english: day has at least 4 parts, drawn with pie() and a title
yoruba: day ní ìpín mẹ́rin ó kéré tán, tí a fi pie() yà pẹ̀lú àkọlé

english: Which day was the hottest? What will R print?
yoruba: Ọjọ́ wo ló gbóná jù? Kí ni R yóò tẹ̀ jáde?

english: which.max() tells you WHERE the biggest number is. 33 is in place number 4.
yoruba: which.max() ń sọ IBI tí nọ́mbà tí ó tóbi jù wà. 33 wà ní ipò kẹrin.

english: Draw a line chart of how much rain fell in your town over 5 days (you can make up the numbers). Use type = "o", a blue colour, and label the bottom with xlab.
yoruba: Ya àwòrán ìlà nípa iye òjò tí ó rọ̀ ní ìlú rẹ fún ọjọ́ márùn-ún (o lè dá àwọn nọ́mbà náà). Lo type = "o", àwọ̀ búlúù, kí o sì kọ orúkọ sísàlẹ̀ pẹ̀lú xlab.

english: A blue line chart with type = "o" and xlab
yoruba: Àwòrán ìlà búlúù pẹ̀lú type = "o" àti xlab

english: 15 is 13 or more, so the rule is TRUE and R takes the first path.
yoruba: 15 jẹ́ 13 tàbí jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ, nítorí náà òfin náà jẹ́ òtítọ́, R sì gba ọ̀nà àkọ́kọ́.

english: Make a weather helper. Set temp <- 34. If temp is more than 30, print "Drink water!", otherwise print "Nice weather!".
yoruba: Ṣe olùrànlọ́wọ́ ojú ọjọ́. Kọ temp <- 34. Bí temp bá ju 30 lọ, tẹ "Drink water!" jáde, bí kò bá rí bẹ́ẹ̀ tẹ "Nice weather!" jáde.

english: Uses if and else, and prints "Drink water!" when temp is 34
yoruba: Lo if àti else, kí ó sì tẹ "Drink water!" jáde nígbà tí temp jẹ́ 34

english: The loop runs 3 times. i is 1, then 2, then 3, and each time R prints i × 2.
yoruba: Ìyípo náà ṣiṣẹ́ lẹ́ẹ̀mẹ́ta. i jẹ́ 1, lẹ́yìn náà 2, lẹ́yìn náà 3, ní ìgbà kọ̀ọ̀kan R sì tẹ i × 2 jáde.

english: Use a for-loop to print "Thank you, God!" three times.
yoruba: Lo for-loop láti tẹ "Thank you, God!" jáde lẹ́ẹ̀mẹ́ta.

english: "Thank you, God!" appears 3 times, using for
yoruba: "Thank you, God!" hàn lẹ́ẹ̀mẹ́ta, pẹ̀lú for

english: n goes 1, 2, 4, 8, 16. 16 is still less than 20, so it doubles once more to 32, and then the loop stops.
yoruba: n lọ láti 1, 2, 4, 8, 16. 16 ṣì kéré sí 20, nítorí náà ó di ìlọ́po méjì lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i sí 32, lẹ́yìn náà ìyípo náà dúró.

english: Savings goal! Start with money <- 0. Use a while-loop to keep adding 300 until you have at least 2000. Then print money.
yoruba: Àfojúsùn ìfowópamọ́! Bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú money <- 0. Lo while-loop láti máa fi 300 kún un títí tí yóò fi tó 2000 ó kéré tán. Lẹ́yìn náà tẹ money jáde.
Lo while, R sì tẹ 2100 jáde

english: double() takes the number you give it and multiplies it by 2.
yoruba: double() ń mú nọ́mbà tí o fún un, ó sì ń fi 2 sọ ọ́ di púpọ̀.

english: Write a function called bless that takes a name and says "God bless you, <name>!". Then use it for 2 people.
yoruba: Kọ function kan tí a ń pè ní bless tí ó gba orúkọ, tí ó sì sọ pé "God bless you, <orúkọ>!". Lẹ́yìn náà lò ó fún ènìyàn méjì.

english: bless is a function, and "God bless you" appears twice
yoruba: bless jẹ́ function, "God bless you" sì hàn lẹ́ẹ̀mejì

english: You run sample(1:6, 1) two times. What happens?
yoruba: O ṣe sample(1:6, 1) lẹ́ẹ̀mejì. Kí ló máa ṣẹlẹ̀?

english: You might get different numbers | You always get 6 | R shows an error
yoruba: O lè rí nọ́mbà tí ó yàtọ̀ | Ìgbà gbogbo ni o máa rí 6 | R máa fi àṣìṣe hàn

english: sample() picks at random, like rolling a dice. Each roll can be different.
yoruba: sample() ń yan láìròtẹ́lẹ̀, bí ìgbà tí a bá ju dáìsì. Ìjù kọ̀ọ̀kan lè yàtọ̀.

english: Make a dice! Use sample() to roll a 6-sided dice 3 times at once, with size = 3 and replace = TRUE (so the same number can come again).
yoruba: Ṣe dáìsì kan! Lo sample() láti ju dáìsì oníhà mẹ́fà lẹ́ẹ̀mẹ́ta lẹ́ẹ̀kan náà, pẹ̀lú size = 3 àti replace = TRUE (kí nọ́mbà kan náà lè tún jáde).

english: R prints 3 dice rolls between 1 and 6
yoruba: R tẹ ìjù dáìsì mẹ́ta láàrin 1 àti 6 jáde

english: R multiplies every item in the list by 10, all at once.
yoruba: R ń fi 10 sọ gbogbo nǹkan inú àkọsílẹ̀ di púpọ̀, lẹ́ẹ̀kan náà.

english: Prices went up! Make a list called prices with 3 prices in Naira. Then show the new prices if each one goes up by 500.
yoruba: Owó ọjà gòkè! Ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ kan tí a ń pè ní prices pẹ̀lú iye owó mẹ́ta ní Náírà. Lẹ́yìn náà fi iye owó tuntun hàn bí ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan bá fi 500 gòkè.

english: prices has 3 numbers, and R prints prices + 500
yoruba: prices ní nọ́mbà mẹ́ta, R sì tẹ prices + 500 jáde

english: sort() puts the numbers in order, smallest first.
yoruba: sort() ń tò àwọn nọ́mbà, láti kékeré jù lọ.

english: Make a list called books with 4 books of the Bible, then put them in ABC order with sort().
yoruba: Ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ kan tí a ń pè ní books pẹ̀lú ìwé mẹ́rin nínú Bíbélì, lẹ́yìn náà tò wọ́n ní ìlànà ABD pẹ̀lú sort().

english: books has 4 names, sorted with sort()
yoruba: books ní orúkọ mẹ́rin, tí a fi sort() tò

english: R starts counting at 1, so days[2] is the second item.
yoruba: R ń bẹ̀rẹ̀ kíkà láti 1, nítorí náà days[2] ni nǹkan kejì.

english: Make a list called week with the 7 days of the week, from Monday to Sunday. Then print only Sunday using [ ].
yoruba: Ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ kan tí a ń pè ní week pẹ̀lú ọjọ́ méje inú ọ̀sẹ̀, láti Monday dé Sunday. Lẹ́yìn náà tẹ Sunday nìkan jáde pẹ̀lú [ ].

english: week has 7 days, and week[ ] prints "Sunday"
yoruba: week ní ọjọ́ méje, week[ ] sì tẹ "Sunday" jáde

english: 5 + 5 is 10, so "is it equal to 10?" is TRUE.
yoruba: 5 + 5 jẹ́ 10, nítorí náà "ṣé ó dọ́gba pẹ̀lú 10?" jẹ́ TRUE (òtítọ́).

english: Make a list called heights with the heights of 5 children in cm. Then ask R which ones are taller than 120 with >.
yoruba: Ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ kan tí a ń pè ní heights pẹ̀lú gíga ọmọdé márùn-ún ní cm. Lẹ́yìn náà bi R èyí tí ó ga ju 120 lọ pẹ̀lú >.

english: heights has 5 numbers, and R prints TRUE and FALSE answers
yoruba: heights ní nọ́mbà márùn-ún, R sì tẹ ìdáhùn TRUE àti FALSE jáde

english: market$price is the price column. sum() adds it up: 2500 + 3000 = 5500.
yoruba: market$price ni òpó iye owó. sum() ń ṣe àròpọ̀ rẹ̀: 2500 + 3000 = 5500.

english: Find the cheapest price on the market list with min(), and count how many items there are with nrow().
yoruba: Wá iye owó tí ó kéré jù nínú àkọsílẹ̀ ọjà pẹ̀lú min(), kí o sì ka iye nǹkan tí ó wà pẹ̀lú nrow().

english: R prints 600 using min(), and 5 using nrow()
yoruba: R tẹ 600 jáde pẹ̀lú min(), àti 5 pẹ̀lú nrow()

english: cumsum() keeps a running total: 100, then 100 + 200, then 100 + 200 + 300.
yoruba: cumsum() ń ṣe àròpọ̀ bí ó ti ń lọ: 100, lẹ́yìn náà 100 + 200, lẹ́yìn náà 100 + 200 + 300.

english: You save ₦200 in week 1, and ₦50 more every week after that (200, 250, 300 …) for 6 weeks. seq(200, by = 50, length.out = 6) makes that list. Use cumsum() to see your savings grow, print them, and draw them.
yoruba: O fi ₦200 pamọ́ ní ọ̀sẹ̀ kìíní, ₦50 sì ń lékún sí i ní ọ̀sẹ̀ kọ̀ọ̀kan lẹ́yìn náà (200, 250, 300 …) fún ọ̀sẹ̀ mẹ́fà. seq(200, by = 50, length.out = 6) ń ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ yẹn. Lo cumsum() láti rí bí owó rẹ ṣe ń pọ̀ sí i, tẹ̀ ẹ́ jáde, kí o sì yà á.

english: Uses seq() and cumsum(), prints 1950, and draws a chart
yoruba: Lo seq() àti cumsum(), tẹ 1950 jáde, kí o sì ya àwòrán

english: 5000 people shared 5 loaves: that is 1000 people for every loaf. Only God could do that!
yoruba: Ènìyàn 5000 pín búrẹ́dì márùn-ún: ìyẹn ni ènìyàn 1000 fún búrẹ́dì kọ̀ọ̀kan. Ọlọ́run nìkan ló lè ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀!

english: Let's pretend each of the 12 baskets held 30 pieces of bread. Make R work out how many pieces were left over, and say it with cat().
yoruba: Ẹ jẹ́ ká díbọ́n pé agbọ̀n méjìlá kọ̀ọ̀kan gba búrẹ́dì 30. Jẹ́ kí R ṣírò iye búrẹ́dì tí ó ṣẹ́kù, kí o sì sọ ọ́ pẹ̀lú cat().

english: R works out 12 × 30 = 360 and says it with cat()
yoruba: R ṣírò 12 × 30 = 360, ó sì sọ ọ́ pẹ̀lú cat()

english: paste0() glues words together with no space in between.
yoruba: paste0() ń lẹ ọ̀rọ̀ pọ̀ láìsí àlàfo láàrin wọn.

english: Make a username for a game: glue "ada" and 2026 together with paste0(), so R prints "ada2026".
yoruba: Ṣe orúkọ olùmúlò fún eré kan: lẹ "ada" àti 2026 pọ̀ pẹ̀lú paste0(), kí R tẹ "ada2026" jáde.

english: nchar() counts the letters: J-e-s-u-s is 5 letters.
yoruba: nchar() ń ka lẹ́tà: J-e-s-u-s jẹ́ lẹ́tà márùn-ún.

english: Put the name of your town in a box called town. Make R shout it in capital letters, and count its letters.
yoruba: Fi orúkọ ìlú rẹ sínú àpótí kan tí a ń pè ní town. Jẹ́ kí R kígbe rẹ̀ ní lẹ́tà ńlá, kí o sì ka lẹ́tà rẹ̀.
substr(word, 1, 5) ń mú lẹ́tà kìíní dé ìkarùn-ún.

english: Split "The Lord is my shepherd" (Psalm 23:1) into words with strsplit(). Count the words with length(), then print the first word.
yoruba: Gé "The Lord is my shepherd" (Orin Dáfídì 23:1) sí ọ̀rọ̀ kọ̀ọ̀kan pẹ̀lú strsplit(). Ka àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ náà pẹ̀lú length(), lẹ́yìn náà tẹ ọ̀rọ̀ àkọ́kọ́ jáde.

english: rev() turns the list around, so the last item comes first.
yoruba: rev() ń yí àkọsílẹ̀ padà, kí nǹkan ìkẹyìn lè wá ṣáájú.

english: Make your own function is_pal(word) that gives TRUE when a word reads the same backwards. Test it on "racecar" and "Lagos".
yoruba: Ṣe function tìrẹ is_pal(word) tí yóò fún wa ní TRUE nígbà tí ọ̀rọ̀ kan bá rí bákan náà tí a bá kà á sẹ́yìn. Dán an wò lórí "racecar" àti "Lagos".

english: is_pal is a function that says TRUE for racecar and FALSE for Lagos
yoruba: is_pal jẹ́ function tí ó sọ TRUE fún racecar àti FALSE fún Lagos

english: ncol() counts the columns. iris has 5: four measurements and the Species name.
yoruba: ncol() ń ka àwọn òpó. iris ní márùn-ún: ìwọ̀n mẹ́rin àti orúkọ Species.

english: R has another dataset called trees, about 31 cherry trees. Show its first 3 rows with head(trees, 3), and count the trees with nrow().
yoruba: R ní dátà mìíràn tí a ń pè ní trees, nípa igi ṣẹ́rì 31. Fi ìlà mẹ́ta àkọ́kọ́ rẹ̀ hàn pẹ̀lú head(trees, 3), kí o sì ka àwọn igi náà pẹ̀lú nrow().
Lo head(trees, 3), R sì tẹ 31 jáde

english: table() counts each kind and lists them in ABC order, so "no" comes before "yes".
yoruba: table() ń ka irú kọ̀ọ̀kan, ó sì ń tò wọ́n ní ìlànà ABD, nítorí náà "no" ló ṣáájú "yes".

english: Girth means how thick a tree is. Find the average Girth of the trees, rounded to 1 decimal place.
yoruba: Girth túmọ̀ sí bí igi ṣe nípọn tó. Wá ìpíndọ́gba Girth àwọn igi náà, kí o sì yí i sí ibi ìdámẹ́wàá kan.

english: Uses mean() and round(), and R prints 13.2
yoruba: Lo mean() àti round(), R sì tẹ 13.2 jáde

english: range() gives the smallest and the biggest value. A histogram shows everything in between.
yoruba: range() ń fún wa ní iye tí ó kéré jù àti èyí tí ó tóbi jù. Histogram ń fi gbogbo èyí tí ó wà láàrin wọn hàn.

english: Draw a histogram of how tall the trees are (trees$Height). Pick your own colour, and add a title with main and a label with xlab.
yoruba: Ya histogram nípa bí àwọn igi ṣe ga tó (trees$Height). Yan àwọ̀ tìrẹ, kí o sì fi àkọlé kún un pẹ̀lú main àti orúkọ pẹ̀lú xlab.

english: A histogram of trees$Height with main and xlab
yoruba: Histogram trees$Height pẹ̀lú main àti xlab

english: The median is the middle number after sorting: 3, 4, 9. The thick line in a box plot is the median.
yoruba: Median ni nọ́mbà àárín lẹ́yìn títò: 3, 4, 9. Ìlà tí ó nípọn nínú box plot ni median.

english: Compare the Sepal.Width of the three iris species with a box plot. Which species has the widest sepals?
yoruba: Fi Sepal.Width irú iris mẹ́ta wéra pẹ̀lú box plot. Irú wo ló ní sepal tí ó fẹ̀ jù?

english: A box plot of Sepal.Width ~ Species
order() gives the PLACES in sorted order. The smallest, 10, is in place 2, then 20 in place 3, then 30 in place 1.
yoruba: order() ń fún wa ní IPÒ wọn ní títò. Èyí tí ó kéré jù, 10, wà ní ipò 2, lẹ́yìn náà 20 ní ipò 3, lẹ́yìn náà 30 ní ipò 1.

english: Show the class table sorted from the lowest score to the highest. Then print only the name of the top student, using which.max().
yoruba: Fi tábìlì kíláàsì hàn ní títò láti máàkì tí ó kéré jù dé èyí tí ó ga jù. Lẹ́yìn náà tẹ orúkọ akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tí ó ṣe dáadáa jù nìkan jáde, pẹ̀lú which.max().

english: Sorts with order(), and R prints "Chidi"
yoruba: Tò pẹ̀lú order(), R sì tẹ "Chidi" jáde

english: b was left out, so its default, 10, is used: 5 + 10 = 15.
yoruba: A kò fi b sí i, nítorí náà a lo ìyàn-àtilẹ̀wá rẹ̀, 10: 5 + 10 = 15.

english: Write a function to_fahrenheit(c) that changes °C to °F with c * 9 / 5 + 32. Test it on 0 and 100.
yoruba: Kọ function to_fahrenheit(c) tí yóò yí °C padà sí °F pẹ̀lú c * 9 / 5 + 32. Dán an wò lórí 0 àti 100.

english: Each time round, k is added to total: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10.
yoruba: Ní ìgbà kọ̀ọ̀kan, a fi k kún total: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10.

english: Use a for-loop over 1:20 to build a list called evens with only the even numbers. Tip: n %% 2 == 0 is TRUE for even numbers.
yoruba: Lo for-loop lórí 1:20 láti kọ́ àkọsílẹ̀ kan tí a ń pè ní evens pẹ̀lú àwọn nọ́mbà tí ó ṣeé pín sí méjì nìkan. Ìmọ̀ràn: n %% 2 == 0 jẹ́ TRUE fún irú nọ́mbà bẹ́ẹ̀.

english: evens is 2, 4, 6 … 20, built with for and if
yoruba: evens jẹ́ 2, 4, 6 … 20, tí a fi for àti if kọ́

english: sqrt() finds the square root. sapply() does it to 1, 4 and 9, one by one.
yoruba: sqrt() ń wá gbòǹgbò onígun mẹ́rin. sapply() ń ṣe é sí 1, 4 àti 9, ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan.

english: Make a list of 3 words. Use sapply() with your own function to shout each one: capital letters with "!" on the end.
yoruba: Ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ mẹ́ta. Lo sapply() pẹ̀lú function tìrẹ láti kígbe ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan: lẹ́tà ńlá pẹ̀lú "!" ní ìparí.

english: Uses sapply(), and R prints words like AMEN!
yoruba: Lo sapply(), R sì tẹ ọ̀rọ̀ bíi AMEN! jáde

english: Each row is added on its own: 1 + 3 = 4 and 2 + 4 = 6.
yoruba: A ṣe àròpọ̀ ìlà kọ̀ọ̀kan fúnra rẹ̀: 1 + 3 = 4 àti 2 + 4 = 6.

english: Add a column called big that is TRUE when bags is 30 or more. Then print only the names of the crops with a big harvest.
yoruba: Fi òpó kan tí a ń pè ní big kún un, tí yóò jẹ́ TRUE nígbà tí bags bá jẹ́ 30 tàbí jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ. Lẹ́yìn náà tẹ orúkọ àwọn ohun ọ̀gbìn tí ìkórè wọn pọ̀ nìkan jáde.

english: farm$big is right, and R prints "Maize" "Beans"
yoruba: farm$big tọ́, R sì tẹ "Maize" "Beans" jáde

english: Group a is 2 + 4 = 6, and group b is 6 + 8 = 14.
yoruba: Ẹgbẹ́ a jẹ́ 2 + 4 = 6, ẹgbẹ́ b sì jẹ́ 6 + 8 = 14.

english: Which month was the windiest? Use tapply() to find the average Wind for each Month of airquality, rounded to 1 decimal place.
yoruba: Oṣù wo ni atẹ́gùn fẹ́ jù? Lo tapply() láti rí ìpíndọ́gba Wind fún oṣù kọ̀ọ̀kan nínú airquality, kí o sì yí i sí ibi ìdámẹ́wàá kan.

english: Uses tapply() on airquality$Wind, and R prints 11.6 for May
yoruba: Lo tapply() lórí airquality$Wind, R sì tẹ 11.6 jáde fún May

english: ifelse() checks each item: 5 is not more than 100 ("dry"), but 150 is ("wet").
yoruba: ifelse() ń ṣàyẹ̀wò nǹkan kọ̀ọ̀kan: 5 kò ju 100 lọ ("dry"), ṣùgbọ́n 150 jù ú lọ ("wet").

english: Tell your own story: put 5 numbers of your own in my_data, then draw a bar chart with ifelse() colours, a dashed average line with abline() and a legend().
yoruba: Sọ ìtàn tìrẹ: fi nọ́mbà márùn-ún tìrẹ sínú my_data, lẹ́yìn náà ya àwòrán ọ̀pá pẹ̀lú àwọ̀ ifelse(), ìlà ìpíndọ́gba onígbálàá pẹ̀lú abline() àti legend().

english: my_data has 5 numbers and the chart has ifelse, abline and legend
yoruba: my_data ní nọ́mbà márùn-ún, àwòrán náà sì ní ifelse, abline àti legend
Títẹ̀ jáde, ìṣirò àti àwọn àpótí (variables)

english: Make R print words and numbers
yoruba: Jẹ́ kí R tẹ ọ̀rọ̀ àti nọ́mbà jáde
Lo R gẹ́gẹ́ bí ẹ̀rọ ìṣirò
Fi nǹkan pamọ́ sínú àpótí tí ó ní orúkọ (variables)

english: Make lists (vectors) of numbers and words
Add up, sort and find the biggest
yoruba: Ṣe àròpọ̀, tò, kí o sì wá èyí tí ó tóbi jù

english: Scatter, bar, pie and line charts
yoruba: Àwòrán ààmì, ọ̀pá, àkàrà àti ìlà

english: Draw scatter, bar, pie and line charts
yoruba: Ya àwòrán ààmì, ọ̀pá, àkàrà àti ìlà
Sọ ohun tí àwòrán kan ń fi hàn

english: If/else, loops, functions and random numbers
yoruba: Bí/bí kò ṣe, ìyípo, function àti nọ́mbà láìròtẹ́lẹ̀

english: Make decisions with if and else
yoruba: Ṣe ìpinnu pẹ̀lú if àti else

english: Repeat things with for and while loops
yoruba: Tún nǹkan ṣe pẹ̀lú for àti while
Tábìlì (data frame) àti ìṣirò ayé gidi
Fi dátà pamọ́ sínú tábìlì (data frames)

english: Pick columns with $ and rows with [ ]
yoruba: Yan òpó pẹ̀lú $ àti ìlà pẹ̀lú [ ]

english: Solve real money and Bible maths problems
yoruba: Yanjú ìṣòro owó àti ìṣirò Bíbélì gidi
Dída ọ̀rọ̀ pọ̀, gígé wọn àti yíyí wọn padà
Yí ọ̀rọ̀ padà, kà á, kí o sì gé e

english: Real datasets, counts, averages, histograms and box plots
yoruba: Dátà gidi, kíkà, ìpíndọ́gba, histogram àti box plot
Kà, wá ìpíndọ́gba, kí o sì ṣàkópọ̀

english: Functions that return answers, building results, sapply(), new columns, groups and good charts
yoruba: Function tí ń dá ìdáhùn padà, kíkọ́ èsì, sapply(), òpó tuntun, ẹgbẹ́ àti àwòrán tí ó dára

english: Write functions that give back answers
yoruba: Kọ function tí ń dá ìdáhùn padà

english: Build results with loops and sapply()
yoruba: Kọ́ èsì pẹ̀lú ìyípo àti sapply()

english: Add columns, group data and make a clear chart
yoruba: Fi òpó kún un, pín dátà sí ẹgbẹ́, kí o sì ṣe àwòrán tí ó ṣe kedere

english: A farm has 3 chickens (2 legs each) and 4 goats (4 legs each). How many legs are there altogether?
yoruba: Oko kan ní adìẹ mẹ́ta (ẹsẹ̀ méjì ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan) àti ewúrẹ́ mẹ́rin (ẹsẹ̀ mẹ́rin ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan). Ẹsẹ̀ mélòó ló wà lápapọ̀?

english: %% gives the remainder after dividing. Use it to check if 2026 is even: is 2026 %% 2 equal to 0?
yoruba: %% ń fún wa ní èyí tí ó ṣẹ́kù lẹ́yìn pípín. Lò ó láti ṣàyẹ̀wò bóyá 2026 ṣeé pín sí méjì: ṣé 2026 %% 2 dọ́gba pẹ̀lú 0?

english: Make R count down from 10 to 1 in one line. Tip: 10:1 counts backwards!
yoruba: Jẹ́ kí R ka sẹ́yìn láti 10 dé 1 ní ìlà kan. Ìmọ̀ràn: 10:1 ń ka sẹ́yìn!

english: What do you get if you add up every number from 1 to 100? R can do it in a flash with sum().
yoruba: Kí ni o máa rí bí o bá ṣe àròpọ̀ gbogbo nọ́mbà láti 1 dé 100? R lè ṣe é kíákíá pẹ̀lú sum().

english: Which name is the longest? Use nchar() and which.max() to find it.
yoruba: Orúkọ wo ló gùn jù? Lo nchar() àti which.max() láti rí i.

english: Make R print the first 5 square numbers (1, 4, 9, 16, 25) in one line, using ^.
yoruba: Jẹ́ kí R tẹ nọ́mbà onígun mẹ́rin márùn-ún àkọ́kọ́ (1, 4, 9, 16, 25) jáde ní ìlà kan, pẹ̀lú ^.

english: How many mangoes are in the basket? fruits == "mango" gives TRUE for each mango, and sum() counts the TRUEs.
yoruba: Máńgòrò mélòó ló wà nínú agbọ̀n? fruits == "mango" ń fún wa ní TRUE fún máńgòrò kọ̀ọ̀kan, sum() sì ń ka àwọn TRUE.

english: It is 30 °C in Abuja. Change it to °F with: C × 9 ÷ 5 + 32.
yoruba: Ìgbóná jẹ́ 30 °C ní Àbújá. Yí i padà sí °F pẹ̀lú: C × 9 ÷ 5 + 32.

english: God worked six days and rested on the seventh (Genesis 2:2). Use rep() to make a list with "work" 6 times, then add "rest".
yoruba: Ọlọ́run ṣiṣẹ́ fún ọjọ́ mẹ́fà, ó sì sinmi ní ọjọ́ keje (Jẹ́nẹ́sísì 2:2). Lo rep() láti ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ pẹ̀lú "work" lẹ́ẹ̀mẹ́fà, lẹ́yìn náà fi "rest" kún un.

english: R prints "work" 6 times and then "rest", using rep()
yoruba: R tẹ "work" jáde lẹ́ẹ̀mẹ́fà, lẹ́yìn náà "rest", pẹ̀lú rep()

english: Print 9 × 1 up to 9 × 5 in one line, with no loop. Tip: multiply 9 by 1:5.
yoruba: Tẹ 9 × 1 dé 9 × 5 jáde ní ìlà kan, láìsí ìyípo. Ìmọ̀ràn: fi 1:5 sọ 9 di púpọ̀.

english: How far apart are the biggest and smallest numbers? Use max() and min().
yoruba: Báwo ni nọ́mbà tí ó tóbi jù àti èyí tí ó kéré jù ṣe jìnnà síra tó? Lo max() àti min().

english: R knows the number pi. Print it rounded to 2 decimal places with round().
yoruba: R mọ nọ́mbà pi. Tẹ̀ ẹ́ jáde ní ibi ìdámẹ́wàá méjì pẹ̀lú round().

english: How many seconds are in one day? (60 seconds, 60 minutes, 24 hours.)
yoruba: Ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá mélòó ló wà nínú ọjọ́ kan? (Ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 60, ìṣẹ́jú 60, wákàtí 24.)

english: A jar has 25 coins of ₦10 and 12 coins of ₦20. How much money is in the jar?
yoruba: Ìgò kan ní owó ẹyọ ₦10 mẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́dọ́gbọ̀n àti owó ẹyọ ₦20 méjìlá. Owó mélòó ló wà nínú ìgò náà?
Borí eré kan ní ìpele Le

english: Play a tune you made in R
yoruba: Ṣe orin tí o kọ nínú R
Ṣe kóòdù tí a fi bulọ́ọ̀kù ṣe

english: Get 10 Predict questions right first time
yoruba: Gba ìbéèrè Sọ tẹ́lẹ̀ 10 tọ̀nà ní ìgbà àkọ́kọ́

english: Solve today's puzzle 7 days in a row
yoruba: Yanjú àdìtú òní fún ọjọ́ méje léraléra

english: Score 8 or more in the speed quiz
yoruba: Gba 8 tàbí jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ nínú ìdánwò kíákíá
